summary: Vikunja is a self-hosted to-do/task management app: projects, tasks, kanban buckets, project views, teams, user/team sharing (with a 0=read/1=write/2=admin Permission), labels, time tracking, saved filters, comments, mentions, reactions, subscriptions, notifications, link sharing, API tokens, sessions, OAuth codes, webhooks, bot users, and an admin panel, all backed by a SQL relational DB via the XORM ORM.
